exact.cBioPortal is a multimodal cancer data v: cBioPortal 是一款多模态癌症数据可视化工具，支持多种数据类型。对某些数据类型我们提供显式支持；对其他类型，您可以借助通用检测或临床数据把任意数据分配给样本或患者。除了将数据直接纳入 cBioPortal，还可以接入针对特定数据类型定制的额外外部查看器，甚至完全不同的仪表板或门户。这种结构化与灵活数据格式的结合，加上链接到其他查看器的选项，使 cBioPortal 能用于临床数据与检测方法的各种组合。

templates.pat: The cBioPortal for Cancer Genomics was originally developed at {{1}} (MSK). The {{2}} is hosted by the {{3}} at MSK. The cBioPortal software is now available under an open source license via {{4}}. The software is now developed and maintained by a multi-institutional team, consisting of MSK, the Dana Farber Cancer Institute, Princess Margaret Cancer Centre in Toronto, Children's Hospital of Philadelphia, {{5}} and {{6}} in the Netherlands, and Bilkent University in Ankara, Turkey.
templates.zh: cBioPortal 癌症基因组学平台最初由 {{1}}（MSK）开发。{{2}}由 MSK 的 {{3}} 托管。cBioPortal 软件现已通过 {{4}} 以开源许可证提供。该软件目前由多机构团队开发与维护，成员包括 MSK、Dana Farber 癌症研究所、多伦多玛格丽特公主癌症中心、费城儿童医院、荷兰的 {{5}} 与 {{6}}，以及土耳其安卡拉的比尔肯特大学。

templates.pat: There are several other data types for which there is no native support. However cBioPortal offers a generic way of linking in additional viewers using the {{1}}. Technically this is known as an iframe link. These viewers can be linked at the cohort, patient or individual sample level. Beyond just linking viewers, we also have several suggestions on what kind of derived data can be added from these assays directly into cBioPortal for multimodal analysis. This mainly leverages the {{2}}.
templates.zh: 还有若干数据类型没有原生支持。不过 cBioPortal 提供了一种通用方式，用 {{1}} 接入额外查看器。技术上这称为 iframe 链接。这些查看器可以在队列、患者或单个样本层级链接。除了链接查看器，我们还就这些检测可向 cBioPortal 直接添加哪些衍生数据以进行多模态分析给出了若干建议。这主要借助 {{2}}。

templates.pat: A linked resource can also carry per-item metadata — the stain, magnification or percent tumor cells of an individual slide, say. Those fields become searchable, sortable and filterable columns in the study's Files & Links tab, so a researcher can narrow thousands of linked images down to the few worth opening instead of paging through a list of links. A curator decides how each field is labelled, typed and filtered through the {{1}}.
templates.zh: 链接资源还可以携带逐项元数据——比如单张切片的染色、放大倍数或肿瘤细胞百分比。这些字段会成为研究“文件与链接”标签页中可搜索、可排序、可筛选的列，研究者因此能把成千上万的链接图像缩小到少数值得打开的几个，而不必逐页翻链接列表。管理员通过 {{1}} 决定每个字段如何标注、如何定类型和如何筛选。

templates.pat: The clinical data are free-form de-identified patient and sample attributes. We don't follow a specific ontology, but rely on the authors of the published studies to determine the organization of their clinical data. The only exception is the cancer type categorization which uses the {{1}} ontology. We do allow encoding of the data type for each column (e.g. numerical, text, etc). More details can be found in the {{2}}. We also have a {{3}} for incorporating treatment information (see e.g. {{4}} AACR GENIE lung cancer case).
templates.zh: 临床数据是自由格式的去标识化患者与样本属性。我们不遵循特定本体，而是由已发表研究的作者决定其临床数据的组织方式。唯一例外是癌症类型分类，它使用 {{1}} 本体。我们允许为每一列标注数据类型（例如数值、文本等）。更多细节见{{2}}。我们还提供{{3}}，用于纳入治疗信息（例如参见{{4}} AACR GENIE 肺癌病例）。

templates.zh: cBioPortal 的私有实例由{{1}}的机构与企业维护。

templates.pat: The cBioPortal REST API is described using Swagger/OpenAPI, which allows one to generate a client in most programming languages. One can use the command line tool {{1}} for downloading data on the command line or use another language such as {{2}} or {{3}} to make visualizations. We list some common examples below, but if your language is not listed, there is likely a client generator available elsewhere (see e.g. {{4}}). Do reach out if you'd like us to add a language.
templates.zh: cBioPortal REST API 使用 Swagger/OpenAPI 描述，因而可以为大多数编程语言生成客户端。可以使用命令行工具 {{1}} 在命令行下载数据，或使用 {{2}}、{{3}} 等其他语言制作可视化。下面列出一些常见示例；如果您的语言未列出，通常也能在其他地方找到客户端生成器（例如参见 {{4}}）。如果希望我们添加某种语言，欢迎联系我们。
